'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Dan Kim LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WHAP 2.0
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
